newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunman kills another Pakistani Shi'ite activist.
newsitem.headline: Gunman kills another Pakistani Shi'ite activist.

text.p: A gunman shot dead a Shi'ite Moslem activist in the Pakistani city of Lahore on Tuesday, the latest in a series of sectarian incidents, police said.
Ali Afzal Shamsi, a doctor, was killed at his clinic by an unidentified man with a pistol who fled the scene, police said.

Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif said in a speech in Islamabad on Tuesday his government would strive for peace between rival groups but would take stern action if they failed to resolve their differences.
"We would never hesitate to implement the command of Almighty Allah (to punish trouble-makers)," he said.

Two shootings occurred on Monday, one killing an elderly Shi'ite Moslem shopkeeper and another a leader of a rival group from the Sunni Moslem sect in Lahore, capital of the central province of Punjab.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for any of the attacks, which were assumed to be the latest incidents in the long-running feud between militant Sunni and Shi'ite groups in Pakistan.
Punjab police detained 13 activists from Sunni and Shi'ite groups on Monday under a plan to seize 100 militants ahead of the Shi'ite mourning festival of Ashura next month.
Sunni-Shi'ite unrest often coincides with Ashura.
